digest.component_or_area: Model fallback orchestration and capability resolution
propositions: Configuring a fallback chain causes whole-chain capability intersection that downgrades the primary model's native structured output capability to prompted output, even when the primary is capable and the fallback may never be invoked.

Direct Anthropic Sonnet model has been live-proven to support native structured output and thinking, enabling symmetric fallback configuration with Bedrock Sonnet primary without capability asymmetry.

The existing whole-chain conservative capability intersection mechanism is intentional design; per-attempt capability resolution requires explicit orchestration changes to FallbackModel request shaping, not merely later capability lookup.

Frontier and standard model classes should be configured in rebar.toml with direct Anthropic fallback arms to enable the approved resilience feature, while trivial remains single-arm pending direct Haiku parity measurement.
A valid non-interactive Anthropic credential has been operator-attested through successful live native-output calls, removing the prior fail-closed capability assumption for direct Sonnet.
